# Metadata

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Governance metadata (#40), on a policy, a rule set or a rule. Every
field is optional. Metadata is not decision-relevant: it never changes
what a rule decides (`PolicyDocument::decision_relevant`).

Appears at: `/policy/metadata`, `/rule_sets/metadata`, `/rule_sets/rules/metadata`.

| `comment` | string | no |  | at most 4096 characters | 1.0.0 | A free-text comment. |
